name: SM_Monument_Dink_PR

textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bake private to this asset (not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2): the task for the unclaimed families asks for a baked set per asset, and the surface detail here (see dresses) does not exist in the shared library
pivot: base centre (bbox centre in X/Y, mesh bottom at z = 0), front on -Y
dresses: the "Dink Smallwood" rock: a grey boulder 2.3 m wide and 1.9 m tall with DINK and SMALLWOOD cut into its face in two lines
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: The name is cut with Blender's built-in sans face as a straight boolean cut, so the letters have vertical walls and no chisel V or weathered edges; the original lettering is a heavy gothic. The rock is a displaced sphere with break planes. Stone is one tinted rock scan with procedural moss and lichen; carving detail comes from displacement, not from modelled tool work.
